eventMetadata.context_description: Michigan Wolverines' overwhelming talent edge over Howard Bison, rooted in Big Ten pedigree versus MEAC competition, anchors the 98.6% implied win probability as trader consensus reflects historical dominance in cross-conference mismatches. Michigan boasts superior depth, athleticism, and coaching under Juwan Howard, with recent form showing blowout wins against lesser foes, while Howard struggles offensively against elite defenses. No major injuries reported for key Wolverines like Hunter Dickinson, further solidifying favoritism. Realistic upset paths remain slim but include Michigan foul trouble, Howard's hot 3-point shooting (as in past Cinderella bids), or rest disadvantages if Wolverines overlook the underdog—though such scenarios occur under 2% historically in lopsided spreads.
